description: Returns a WhatsApp link to VYKA's sales line (+971 52 273 1161) with a pre-written first message, about a stone (report number or VYK code) or a vykadiamonds.com product page, in English or Arabic. Use this only when the user asks to contact VYKA, speak to a jeweller or enquire on WhatsApp. Limits: nothing is sent; the user opens the link, can edit the message and sends it themselves. No personal details are asked for or kept.

language.description: Language of the message and the website link.

product_url.description: Optional: a product page on vykadiamonds.com.

stone.description: Optional: the stone's report number or VYK code.

name: talk_to_jeweller

message.description: The pre-written text the user can edit before sending.

stone_found.description: For a stone: whether it is still listed. Null when no stone was given.

website_link.description: The stone or product page the message refers to.

title: Contact a VYKA jeweller on WhatsApp
